content: As mentioned in the previous section, we decided to base the question collection on script scenarios rather than specific texts. As a starting point for our data collection, we use scenarios from three script data collections BIBREF3 , BIBREF11 , BIBREF12 . Together, these resources contain more than 200 scenarios. To make sure that scenarios have different complexity and content, we selected 80 of them and came up with 20 new scenarios. Together with the 10 scenarios from InScript, we end up with a total of 110 scenarios.
